connectors.name: AniKoto
connectors.releaseNotes: 0.3.12 candidate: uses the visible AniKoto heading as the primary AniKage browse title and falls back to data-jp only when the heading is unavailable. The existing AniList banner ID (when present), exact year and format remain selection constraints; duplicate or conflicting matches fail closed. The existing title, episode and koto source routes are unchanged. This candidate has not established broad live reliability, playback recovery or spoken-language verification.

connectors.name: AniKage (BETA)
connectors.releaseNotes: Handles both opaque source tokens and absolute HTTPS source URLs from the source-owned Anikage response using existing bounded URL transforms. Preserves the existing minimum app version, Koto provider, Sub/Dub mapping, subtitles, headers, and host allowlist. Pending live confirmation; no broad reliability claim.

connectors.name: AnimeGG
connectors.releaseNotes: Declares honest per-episode Sub and Dub availability so unavailable audio is disabled before playback.

connectors.name: Update Flow Test
connectors.releaseNotes: Version 1.0.0 for validating Aroki's signed source-update flow.

connectors.name: One Pace
connectors.releaseNotes: M25: Consolidates One Pace into a single stable title on discovery and search. Increases concurrency to 4 workers and raises timeout to 30s so all 485+ episodes across all arcs load smoothly.

connectors.name: Synthetiq One
connectors.releaseNotes: Retired from new installation because current playback is unreliable. Existing saved data and historical connector releases are retained. Choose another active source; this retirement does not delete downloads or library entries.

connectors.name: Synthetiq Anime
connectors.releaseNotes: Owner-authorized public availability for Aroki 2.1.36+. Existing MAL title IDs, episode IDs, catalogue fallback, and AniKage koto source route are preserved. Version 0.1.3 adds a typed graph selector that requires a unique AniKage row matching the canonical AniList ID plus exact normalized title, year and format before resolving the requested episode/audio. Missing, conflicting or duplicate identity fails closed. Broad live reliability, provider-advertised audio agreement, and spoken-language verification remain pending.

connectors.name: Synthetiq Flux
connectors.releaseNotes: Restore native playback through AniPM/Settlar using canonical AniList identifiers. Existing MyAnimeList title IDs, saved shows and episode numbers are preserved. Playback session expiry and supplied captions are retained. Provider availability varies; downloads remain disabled. Requires Aroki 2.0.38 or newer.

connectors.name: AniWorld
connectors.releaseNotes: Owner-approved public availability for Aroki 2.0.36+. Home/Browse discovery and native playback resolver are unchanged. Sub-only: German-subtitle mirror first, English-subtitle fallback; German Dub is not included. Visible captions, spoken language and offline remain unverified.

connectors.name: Anime-Sama
connectors.releaseNotes: 0.3.2 aligns catalogue search with the site's current card markup. Search now reads the as-carte work cards (title from h3.as-carte-titre, source id from the card link) instead of the removed h2.card-title markup. Details, episode panels, variants and stream resolution are unchanged.

connectors.name: AniPM (BETA)
connectors.releaseNotes: Preserve provider-declared playback session expiry so Aroki can refresh expired links. Existing saved titles, audio and subtitles are unchanged.
